title: Counting the End Days of a Period a Protected Vehicle Stood Off the Road
content:
Whether the day the period opens and the day of the appraisal are themselves counted, when a vehicle protected by the Keyturn Host Protection Plan stands off the road, turns on the reporting standing on the enrolment and on whether the vehicle's listing is live.

- Where a report lodged in the month before the appraisal stands on the register and the vehicle's listing is not live on the marketplace, the days run to the day of the appraisal with both end days counted.
- Where such a report stands on the register and the vehicle's listing is live, they run to that day with the first day not counted.
- Where no report lodged in that month stands on the register, they run to that day with neither end day counted.

### The three readings on one period (hypothetical figures)

Take a period opening on a day and appraised 10 days later, so that 10 whole days separate the two.

| Report lodged in the month before | Listing live | Days counted |
|---|---|---|
| yes | no | 11 |
| yes | yes | 10 |
| no | either | 9 |

Both end days counted adds the opening day to the days that separate the two; the first day not counted leaves them as they are; neither end day counted takes one off.

### Records consulted

Whether the listing is live is read from the Keyturn Vehicle Listing for that vehicle, a listing shown as listed being live and any other standing not. The reports counted are those lodged on the damage report register for this enrolment within the month before the appraisal.
